lines.t: Blow the shofar, O people!
Cry out — the King is coming!
Mountains tremble, valleys shine,
For YahuShua draws near in power and light!
I have seen the sun rise upon the mountains of Israel,
I have seen the moonlight illuminate the valleys of Judah,
I have even seen the stars fall from the heavens!
Yet never have I seen a wonder such as this…
A brilliant light, a perfect likeness!
Behold, I stepped into the fire!
Instead of burning, I received understanding;
In place of my wounds, I received healing in this flame!
What a wondrous and beautiful place!
Overwhelming, pure love in the light of His glory!
Consuming me where I stand, strengthening me as I fall,
My tears flowing as my life departs… yet I do not die!
The presence of The Lord of Hosts rises up in me!
Cry out and be remade!
Fall to your knees — let every chain break!
The fire refines, and you emerge purified!
Cry out to the King — be remade, be alive!
Cry out, let your soul awake!
He is the Truth — let every fear shake!
YahuShua reigns — forever the same,
Cry out… be remade… in His Name!
I am losing myself, yet I feel as though I am being born;
I was dead, and now I am alive again…
The man I was passes away,
As His life rushes in!
What more shall I ask of Him?
Only this… MORE!
[Bridge – Prophetic Letter, Deep Male Narrator]
"… For My grace descends upon all who repent in sincerity and in truth,
and My spirit dwells within those who keep The Commandments
and testify to My glory.
Therefore, My son, receive of Me;
then will that which you seek become clear.
For your heart’s true desire cannot be found in the world…
Seek God!”
Says The Lord.
Step into the fire, watch the chains fall!
Hear the King calling, He redeems us all!
Thunder shakes the heavens, shofars split the skies,
Walk through the flame — watch the old man die!
Every sin undone, every fear erased,
Rise in His truth, behold His face!
Cry out, cry out — the King is near!
Be remade, be alive — cast out all fear!
Cry out and be remade!
Through holy fire, unafraid!
The old man falls, the chains are gone,
In YahuShua’s arms, you are reborn!
Walk through the flame — emerge purified,
A child of light, restored inside!
Cry out — and be remade!
For YahuShua saves!
Cry out and be remade!
Through holy fire, unafraid!
The old man falls, the chains are gone,
In YahuShua’s arms, you are reborn!
Walk through the flame — emerge purified,
A child of light, restored inside!
Cry out — and be remade!
For YahuShua saves!
[Outro – Piano, Violin, Harp, Heartbeat Fade]
“For behold… the King comes.”
“Glory to YahuShua… YAHUWAH…”
